mapper.sql: select approval_id, run_id, task_id, task_name, device_id, host_id, host_name, command, risk, reasons, explanation, status, decided_by, decide_comment, expires_at, decided_at, create_time from itm_approval
mapper.insert: insert into itm_approval (approval_id, run_id, task_id, task_name, device_id, host_id, host_name, command, risk, reasons, explanation, status, expires_at, create_time) values (#{approvalId}, #{runId}, #{taskId}, #{taskName}, #{deviceId}, #{hostId}, #{hostName}, #{command}, #{risk}, #{reasons}, #{explanation}, 'PENDING', #{expiresAt}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update itm_approval set status = #{status}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decide_comment = ifnull(#{comment}, ''), decided_at = sysdate() where approval_id = #{approvalId} and status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: select distinct u.user_id from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' left join sys_role_menu rm on rm.role_id = r.role_id left join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and (r.role_key = 'admin' or m.perms = 'itm:approval:decide')
mapper.delete: delete from itm_approval where create_time < #{before} and status != 'PENDING' limit #{limit}
